title: Hello everyone! I'm the new adventurer on the forum!

posts.author: Axgin96
posts.body:
Hi everyone!
My name is Axgin96, nice to meet you! I'm new around here and recently got back into RPG Maker, this time with the
MZ
version. I had already tried RPG Maker VX in the past... with not-so-great results, I’ll admit!
Now, as an adult, I have a clear goal:
to recreate a game inspired by my childhood favorite, Spectrobes
. I know, probably only I and the original developers remember it , but the idea of recreating and replaying a game based on excavation, archaeology, and evolving creatures is a dream come true for me.
During development, I’ll need to create some
custom plugins
for my project. Since I strongly believe in
open source
, I plan to share the most useful and general plugins with the community for free. Maybe I’ll never finish my game… but if even one of my plugins helps someone else complete theirs, that’s more than enough for me!
Thanks for the warm welcome, and see you around the forum!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum and welcome to MZ!
Recreating an older game that you really loved is actually a great way to learn and stay motivated with a project. I recently recreated the character generation portion from the first game I ever played and I learned a TON doing it. And it was fun.
Anyway, good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
